formal_statement: ∀ (n q M : ℕ) (w : (Fin n → Bool) → List Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.QueryLocal n q w → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (w x).length ≤ M) → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => x i = true).card % 2 = 1 → w x ∈ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.PartialMCSP) → 2 * q * (Nat.log 2 M + 2) < n → ∃ (n' s : ℕ) (T : List (Option Bool)), w (fun _ : Fin n => false) = List.replicate s true ++ false :: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.encodePartial T ∧ T.length = 2 ^ n'
plain_statement: CONJECTURE, ours, not found in print: let w map n-bit inputs to strings of length at most M, every output position fixed by at most q input positions (QueryLocal), and every input of odd weight to a member of partial MCSP. If 2q(log2 M + 2) < n then the image of the all-false input has the form 1^s 0 code(T) with T a partial table of length a power of two. Step of the transfer of the 2017 local reduction theorem (Murray and Williams, Theory of Computing 13) to partial MCSP.
title: A q-local map sending odd inputs into partial MCSP sends the zero input to a well-formed instance
